record.short: Zoho CRM moves AI agents from the Standard plan to the Professional plan.
record.headline: Zoho CRM now lists AI agents, which build and deploy agents to automate sales activities, under Professional instead of Standard.
record.who: Customers on the Standard plan who want AI agents. The page does not say whether current Standard customers keep access.
record.read: Zoho is using AI agents as a reason to move CRM buyers from Standard to the pricier Professional plan. It fits a wider pattern of AI features being placed in mid tiers.
record.caveat: Based only on the plan feature lists; the page does not say whether existing Standard customers lose access.
